Both significant results (p = 0.03 and p = 0.04) fail every one of the four corrections -- the surviving interval is 0 to 0, identical under Bonferroni, Holm, Benjamini-Hochberg and Benjamini-Yekutieli, so the conclusion does not depend on which method one prefers.
